players.name: Myles Garrett
players.comment: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Tuesday that Garrett's absence from Monday's practice was a rest day and had nothing to do with his knee injury, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

players.name: Kam Curl
players.comment: Curl has no injury designation for Wednesday night's matchup against the Packers, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

players.name: Quentin Lake
players.comment: Lake posted two tackles (one solo) during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals in Week 10.

players.name: Brandon McManus
players.comment: McManus made both of his field-goal attempts and all four PATs in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

players.name: Konata Mumpfield
players.comment: The Rams are expected to lean more on Mumpfield and the rest of the team's wide receivers in the absence of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), the latter of whom is expected to be sidelined for the remainder of the regular season, Nate Atkins and Jonathan Jones of The Athletic report.

players.name: CJ Daniels
players.comment: Daniels caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.

players.name: Tutu Atwell
players.comment: Atwell caught one of two targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 34-6 win over the Cardinals.

players.name: Steve Avila
players.comment: Coach Sean McVay said Saturday that Avila (hamstring) will not play in Wednesday's game against the Packers, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.comment: Higbee caught three of four targets for 17 yards and a touchdown during the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.comment: Williams (toe) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Zaire Franklin
players.comment: Franklin (shin) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Micah Parsons
players.comment: The Packers reinstated Parsons (knee) from the PUP list on Tuesday.

players.name: Evan Williams
players.comment: Williams logged eight tackles (two solo) and a pass defense during the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.

players.name: Xavier McKinney
players.comment: McKinney registered six tackles (three solo) and an interception during the Packers' 30-10 loss to the Vikings in Week 10.

players.name: Brandon Cisse
players.comment: Cisse (ribs) practiced fully Monday.

players.name: Trey Smack
players.comment: Smack went 1-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his only extra-point try during Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.comment: Watson caught three of five targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to Minnesota.

players.name: Matthew Golden
players.comment: Golden caught five of nine targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

players.name: Savion Williams
players.comment: Williams caught two passes for 27 yards on two targets in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

players.name: Sean Rhyan
players.comment: Rhyan (ankle) is officially questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Kevin Zeitler
players.comment: Zeitler (triceps) is officially questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Jordan Love
players.comment: Love completed 17 of 27 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.comment: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.comment: The Packers list Jacobs (finger) as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.
